name: Bourbon Beard Salve
blurb: A 2 oz tin that softens coarse facial hair, calms the itch underneath, and smells like a stiff drink and cedarwood instead of a drugstore aisle. Light hold, zero grease, genuinely good gift material.

usageGuide.howToApply: Scrape a thumbnail-sized amount, warm between palms until melted, and work upward through beard into the underlying skin. Comb through to style.
usageGuide.storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Keep lid tightly sealed. Shelf life is 6–12 months.
usageGuide.patchTest: Test a small amount on the jawline or inner arm 24 hours prior to full beard application.
